# Locally served browser libraries

These copies replace the existing third-party CDN loads. Keep the adjacent copyright and licence files when redistributing.

| Library | Version | Download source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ | BSD-2-Clause; `leaflet/LICENSE` |
| PeerJS | 1.5.2 | https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.2/dist/peerjs.min.js | MIT; `peerjs/LICENSE` |
| QRCode.js | 1.0.0 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js | MIT; `qrcodejs/LICENSE` |

Leaflet's PNG assets remain in its `images/` directory. QRCode.js's licence is from https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs/blob/master/LICENSE. Optional map tiles, YouTube media/API, and remote signaling remain external services and require the page's explicit activation.
